msg: I'm not sure what the strategy is here. I picked the gnome with the pointy hat, and stuck with them until I got 2 or fewer mushrooms five times in a row, then switched to the other gnome, until they got me 2 or fewer mushrooms in a row. Later I upped this to 3 or fewer, and towards the end when I was getting bored, I only gave them 3 chances to improve their 'advice' before I switched. There was usually a large number of mushrooms after switching - so perhaps I should have switched more often! The game takes quite a long time and is quite tedious so I recommend just picking a strategy that will keep you mildly interested...
